title: festuca acanthophylla var. scabriuscula
intro: Festuca acanthophylla var. scabriuscula, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being.
